workflows.ci.yml:
# The tests need a Pi Pocket checkout: link.mjs symlinks node_modules, _pocket.d.ts and _pocket into the
# checkout at PI_POCKET_CHECKOUT. The job "pocket" clones each pinned Pi Pocket release of the matrix into the
# runner's temporary folder, installs its dependencies, points the links at it, and runs the gate, make ci:
#   - upstream TannerMidd/pi-pocket at v0.27.0, the release to roll back to;
#   - the fork bketelsen/pi-pocket at v0.28.0-bk.1, the server's release: upstream v0.28.0 plus the patches listed
#     in BK-PATCHES.md on its branch bk/v0.28.0.
# Each entry also names the tag's commit, and the job fails when the clone is another one. Actions are pinned by
# commit SHA, and the token can only read (frostyard/core ADR-0021).
# The ruleset requires the check "Test". A matrix job gets 1 check for each entry, named with the entry, so the job
# "Test" waits for every entry and passes only when all of them pass: keep its name.
name: CI

on:
    pull_request:
    push:
        branches: [main]

permissions: {}

concurrency:
    group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
    cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # (job bodies trimmed; only the uses: lines are kept)
              uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
              uses: jdx/mise-action@f5be966e4a917d54244728e6a5fdcd1d93a35e6c # v5.2.6
workflows.risk-paths.yml:
# Risk paths (ADR-0068, docs/specs/risk-paths.md): this caller runs on
# pull_request_target so the base risk list and trusted caller execute. It does
# not run a PR branch. It checks out nothing. It is not a required check. The
# repository must have the risk:high label, or this job fails.
name: Risk paths caller

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  # (job bodies trimmed; only the uses: lines are kept)
    uses: frostyard/core/.github/workflows/risk-paths.yml@1b02a129026329cef2b46d1fbd0465a863c1cd81
workflows.site.yml:
# Build the documentation site for pi-pocket-team and deploy it to GitHub Pages.
# Copy this file to .github/workflows/site.yml. The site itself comes from
# the frostyard-docs-site skill's scaffold, copied as site/.
name: Site
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['site/**', 'Makefile', '.github/workflows/site.yml']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['site/**', 'Makefile', '.github/workflows/site.yml']
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions: {}
jobs:
  # (job bodies trimmed; only the uses: lines are kept)
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@368f82528645a54fb793d4d04e342629a3f51346 # v5.0.1
workflows.upstream.yml:
# Tests this project against upstream Pi Pocket, not the pinned tag that ci.yml uses. The purpose is to see
# a break before the next upstream release. It runs each Monday, and by hand. A red run only warns: this is
# a separate workflow, not a required check, so it never blocks a merge.
#
# To test the next release's draft PR, run it by hand with `ref` set to the draft PR's branch (for example
# release/0.22.0) or to pull/<number>/head:
#   gh workflow run upstream.yml -f ref=pull/150/head
name: Upstream

on:
    schedule:
        - cron: "17 6 * * 1"
    workflow_dispatch:
        inputs:
            ref:
                description: A branch, a tag, or pull/<number>/head of TannerMidd/pi-pocket
                type: string
                default: main
    pull_request:
        paths: [.github/workflows/upstream.yml]

permissions: {}

concurrency:
    group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
    cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # (job bodies trimmed; only the uses: lines are kept)
              uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
              uses: jdx/mise-action@f5be966e4a917d54244728e6a5fdcd1d93a35e6c # v5.2.6
